Coordinates are locality-level and provisional — temple-level coordinates not verified. Town field kept as 'Salem' per CSV pending the exact village.

name: Sundhara Kandhaswamy Temple

town_description: Salem is a major city and district headquarters in north-central Tamil Nadu, known as the 'Steel City' (SAIL Salem Steel Plant), for its mangoes and textiles, and as a pilgrimage base for temples across the district. The Kandhasamy Kovil lies ~22 km out on the Salem-Thiruchengode road, in a rural belt toward Sankagiri (phone STD 04288).
